name: gurb/sdk
description: Official PHP SDK for the Gurb community platform. Reads your community's data, manages members and permissions, and mints embed sessions. Server-side only — it holds your secret API key.

suggest.ext-curl: Needed only by the bundled CurlHttpClient. Inject your own HttpClient and this is not required.
suggest.psr/http-client: Needed only by the optional Psr18HttpClient adapter (Guzzle, Symfony HttpClient, ...).
suggest.psr/http-factory: Needed only by the optional Psr18HttpClient adapter.
